name: Anthropic
baa: HIPAA-ready API organization, with zero data retention (ANTHROPIC.md)
about: Prices are dollars per 1M tokens (ANTHROPIC.md §3; Anthropic's pricing, cached 2026-11-03). Thinking 'off' is the model's own way: `disabled` on Haiku, `between_tools` on Sonnet; Opus 5.5 cannot turn it off. The 5.5 family only, pinned by name. The defaults: the cheapest model first, moving up only when a named test call shows it falls short (VOICE-AGENT.md §8.3; the owner, 2026-10-20); effort low, the fastest first token; max_tokens 1200, since at 600 one reply spent the whole cap thinking (2026-11-12) and of 663 requests the 95th percentile used 261; the retry cap 2400 for a reply cut off with nothing to say (llm.py _CutOffGuard); a $100 budget a month (the owner).
